items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Louis Nelson is a trombone player here

ctx.x: Louis Nelson is a trombone player here, and he had a brother who played saxophone. I don't know his brother's name. I can't think of it now. I knew it years ago.
Now, Louis Barbarin's daughter, that's Paul Barbarin's...

items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah, I read that about your family. You mention quite a few famous musicians in the family in addition to the Barbarins. You say that Louis Barbarin’s daughter had married Louis Nelson, right?
You told us the other day about your uncles, Uncle Paul and Lucien and Louis, and Esther Bigeou, your cousin.
